title: Retire the stale placement/endpoint gaps in a v4 evidence package and make the registry path single-sourced
source_handoff: external review of the Edition 1 draft, findings R01-R04 (GPT-5.6 Sol, high effort, 2026-09-24), verified against the committed artefact by this session
acceptance_criteria: book/evidence/v4/ is the active package: it carries every still-active v3 claim forward content-identically, retires v2-gap-05 and v2-gap-07 through retired_predecessor_claims with the clause each retirement closes, and adds v4-gap-01-physical-placement-unverified and v4-gap-02-endpoint-distribution-partial

The successor gaps state what the Study 05 runs measured (endpoint spread over three endpoints; the key-locality pair executed) and what remains open (tablet/leader placement never observed; studies 01-02 multi-node cells use a single endpoint DSN), and claim no measurement of their own
v1, v2 and v3 packages are byte-unchanged and no existing tag is moved; the v3-to-v4 change is recorded in a SUPERSESSION_LEDGER.md and a signed ANALYSIS.md

tools/evidence gains v4 lifecycle validation (a gap must declare gap_kind; a partly superseded claim must name its successors; a retired claim may not also be active) and `go test ./...` is green including new negative controls
The registry version is a single build input: no Typst source, README or script names a fixed registry version, and book/evidence/check.sh fails the build if one reappears
book/build.sh refuses a concurrent build, writes to --out/--manifest paths, and fails if the unverified-build banner reaches a release PDF

book/concepts/distributed-placement.typ, book/chapters/topologies.typ and book/chapters/major-families.typ no longer state the retired gap text, and book/chapters/evidence-and-reproduction.typ no longer names a v2 registry path
The rebuilt preview PDF reports 29/29 claims indexed with the evidence digest present
expected_artifacts: v4 validation output and go test output
rebuilt preview PDF text showing 29/29 claims
validation: tools/evidence validate-v4 reports 0 errors; validate-v3 still reports 0 errors on the frozen package
book/build.sh --out dist/preview.pdf verifies: 29/29 claims, 5/5 fonts, digest present, no banner
Negative controls introduced and reverted: a retired claim id, an unknown claim id, a fixed registry version in a source, and a preview build without inputs
